payload.rationale: Map one opaque action from the initial state; compare the grid transition to identify the controlled object and direction.
Continue controlled action mapping from player-like object 2 at row 2 column 2; identify whether ACTION2 is a movement direction or non-movement command.
Map another opaque action while object 2 has open space to the right but a blocked object/wall to the left, giving a discriminating transition.
Test ACTION4 from the same discriminating state; movement into open right cell would identify right, while no change narrows it to blocked-left or an auxiliary command.
Move object 2 onto reachable object 3 to test whether colored cells are collectibles/checkpoints and reveal the concrete progress trigger.
Test the non-directional action while object 2 is adjacent to object 3; if it grabs, transforms, or interacts with the neighbor, the resulting state will expose the core puzzle mechanic.
Test whether ACTION7 is the reset command; confirmation enables bounded state-space exploration with reliable return to the initial level.
Move to the left side approach route for object 3 to test whether it is pushable.
Continue around object 3 into its open left-adjacent cell.
Attempt to push object 3 horizontally into the open cell at row 4 column 4, testing Sokoban-style interaction.
Retest ACTION7 after a meaningful box displacement; this distinguishes a state-reset/undo command from an inert auxiliary action.
Begin the inferred Sokoban solution by routing above the movable object without disturbing it.
Continue around the box toward its right side.
Reach the right column so the box can be pushed left.
Move into the box's right-adjacent cell.
Push object 3 left one cell toward object 4, inferred to be its goal.
Push object 3 left again into column 1, aligning it below the goal.
Route below the aligned box through the only open lower corridor.
Move directly below the box for the final upward push.
Push object 3 upward onto object 4; if 4 is the remaining goal this should complete level 1.
With object 3 aligned adjacent to object 4 and the player directly behind it, test whether the auxiliary action performs the required merge/activation that ordinary pushing did not.
Undo the failed alignment experiment to recover a movable box state for alternate-path testing.
Continue undoing through inert/no-op history until a meaningful prior state is restored.
